title: Devils Run
description: Meet Brim, one of many for-contract gem hunters. Brim's latest assignment? A gem-rich planet in the far east, part of the volatile galaxy. All is well until the unthinkable happens; the planet begins to erupt, filling in with lava. Now in a perilous situation, your mission is to jump, flip, and swing through 10 treacherous levels to your ship to escape. While you're on your way back to your ship, collect the gems that you can, imploding planets are no reason to miss quota!
description_short: An indie platformer and race to escape an imploding planet! Time your moves carefully..
